name: 025me5-home-computers
goal: Home hides historical project totals and reports active sessions and heartbeat capacity per computer through the shared Hub and Mac renderers.

evidence: Tracker 025me5 controls shared Mac/iPhone and web Home: historic project totals, per-computer running sessions including leases, and existing heartbeat readings on click.
